tournament.name: BCDL 21 - Ohio - Buffalo Chicken Dip Legacy

decks.notes: The primary focus of this BUG Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, removal spells, and counterspells. The deck aims to maintain control of the board while gradually building card advantage and out-valuing the opponent. It utilizes powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to apply pressure and close out the game. The mana base is designed to provide access to all necessary colors while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces, such as Allosaurus Shepherd and Nomads en-Kor, in order to generate large amounts of mana and tutor for key creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth using cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Leovold, Emissary of Trest to disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent with efficient creature-based combos.

The deck revolves around using a combination of creatures, spells, and mana acceleration to quickly fill the graveyard and win the game in a single turn. By sacrificing creatures like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer, players can mill their entire deck into the graveyard, then use cards like Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return to secure victory. With a heavy focus on fast mana production and graveyard manipulation, the deck aims to combo off and win before the opponent can effectively react.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure with aggressive creatures and efficient spells. By utilizing various cantrips and disruptive counterspells, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and protect its threats. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent helps to apply pressure and close out games swiftly. Overall, the deck aims to out-tempo the opponent and establish dominance on the battlefield through a combination of speed, disruption, and aggression.

This BUG Control deck focuses on disruption and card advantage to control the game. It utilizes a variety of spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan, such as counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, removal like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut, and discard spells like Thoughtseize. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find answers and threats efficiently, along with powerful threats like Murktide Regent and Endurance to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's strategy and provide consistency in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to establish control over the game through disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, while maintaining tempo with cards like Brainstorm and Ponder. The deck combines aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf with evasive threats like Brazen Borrower to put pressure on the opponent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for disruption with cards like Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure and maintaining tempo to secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to quickly and efficiently combo off by milling your entire library and winning the game with Thassa's Oracle or Pact of Negation. This deck relies on using cards like Balustrade Spy, Undercity Informer, and Poxwalkers to quickly mill yourself, while using cards like Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Simian Spirit Guide to generate mana. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to protect its combo. The goal is to win the game as quickly as possible through a powerful graveyard-based strategy.

This deck relies on a fast and efficient mana base to cast a series of spells in order to generate a large storm count and win the game in a single turn. It utilizes cards like Lion's Eye Diamond, Lotus Petal, Dark Ritual, and Cabal Ritual to generate mana quickly, while cards like Infernal Tutor and Burning Wish allow for access to crucial combo pieces. The key goal is to build up a high storm count and finish the game with Tendrils of Agony or other storm finishers. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Duress, Thoughtseize, and Veil of Summer to protect the combo.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo of Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor, with support from cards like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Narcomoeba, to mill the entire library and win with Thassa's Oracle. The deck includes various control elements such as Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Urza's Saga, along with some card selection and protection spells like Brainstorm and Spell Pierce. The mana base includes fetchlands and dual lands for consistency, with Urza's Saga providing additional creature search. The deck tries to combo off quickly while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble the Cephalid Illusionist combo, which uses Cephalid Illusionist, Nomads en-Kor, and a shuffle effect like Nomads en-Kor to mill your library and put Narcomoeba into play. This allows you to either win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return a key creature like Nadu, Winged Wisdom. The deck also includes disruption in the form of counter spells like Force of Will and interaction like Swords to Plowshares, while utilizing card selection and manipulation through cards like Brainstorm and Ponder.

The deck aims to quickly mill oneself using Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor, to get Narcomoeba and other combo pieces into the graveyard. It then uses Dread Return to reanimate a key combo piece like Nadu, Winged Wisdom or Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck includes protection spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, and powerful card draw like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the combo pieces quickly. Urza's Saga provides additional value by searching for key artifacts, while Teferi, Time Raveler and Prismatic Ending offer additional disruption against opponents.

This deck focuses on using disruptive spells and efficient threats to control the game and maintain tempo advantage. By combining removal, counterspells, and card advantage, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with evasive creatures like Baleful Strix and Murktide Regent. The mana base is optimized for consistency and resilience, with a mix of fetchlands and dual lands. The deck is designed to maintain a proactive game plan while disrupting the opponent's strategy, ultimately aiming to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a fast-paced tempo-centric matchup.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo as quickly as possible to mill the opponent's entire library. This combo is further supported by cards like Goblin Engineer and Urza's Saga to tutor for the necessary pieces. In addition, the deck includes tools for disruption and removal, such as Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt, while also utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Ancient Tomb. The goal is to disrupt and overwhelm the opponent through a quick and decisive combo win.

The main strategy of this Jeskai Tempo deck is to control the board using disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy, while also utilizing creature abilities like Goblin Bombardment and Static Prison to put pressure on the opponent. The deck focuses on tempo plays with efficient removal like Swords to Plowshares and versatile creatures like Guide of Souls and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with efficient creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, using counter spells like Daze and Force of Will to protect them. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to control the board. Mishra's Bauble helps cycle through the deck quickly, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder provide card selection and manipulation. The mana base is optimized for the deck's color requirements, with Wasteland included for disruption. Overall, the deck aims to pressure opponents early and maintain control throughout the game.

The deck focuses on card advantage, control, and resource management through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers. It aims to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan while drawing cards and generating value through Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck utilizes a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, along with versatile counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce. Planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide additional control and card advantage, allowing the player to outvalue their opponent in the long game.
